title: Luxe 1 br w/pool ★ David Bowie ★ Sleeps 4 ★
description:
Awaken in a plush queen-sized bed, ready to explore nearby attractions. Make memories toasting the life-sized David Bowie mural.  Recline on a modern chaise sofa in a daylight-filled living room amid trendy furnishings and a wall adorned with inspiring photos of rock music’s finest songwriters. Under 2 miles to Broadway, Vanderbilt, Saint Thomas, the VA and Centennial Hospitals.  

Metro Nashville Permit number 2020_followedby014343

The space
There is no place like The 1865 - it combines classic architecture (rounded brick, original wood beams, dome shaped walls, and cool graffiti) boasting brand new materials and appliances.

Other things to note
The home boasts a collection of some of Nashville's finest rock music memorabilia.

This is a multi-unit property and amenity management and maintenance are outside the host's control. While issues rarely arise, any amenity that is unavailable for any reason, including but not limited to pool, common area, fitness center, etc. is not responsibility of the host. Refunds/cancellations beyond the cancellation period (as detailed at booking) will not be honored for these reasons. Please note these details upon booking.
